reason: Reviewed lifecycle hooks, the shared skill, the Hermes and setup references, CLI readiness and domain terms after splitting Hermes session context into two plugin prompt sections. From Hermes v0.21.5 the plugin asks the CLI for two sections in one call: ownership, notices and a pointer to `notifai guidance` for when the second section is missing; then the same lifecycle guidance every other harness receives, trust text first. Each section stays within 3,900 bytes and both within 7,700, so Notifai's sections never crowd each other out; whichever one Hermes leaves out, no topic renders without the trust text, and nothing is added per turn. An earlier plugin, an earlier CLI, or a Hermes older than v0.21.5 or with an unreadable version keeps the one-section context unchanged. Hermes now receives the update notice at session start like every harness, and `notifai guidance` no longer prints it. harness-hermes.md and the README describe the two sections and the older-Hermes fallback; harness-setup, SKILL, TRUST and domain terms needed no change.
